baseline.method: Converged original 30000-evaluation Nelder-Mead on bound observations; independent repeat exact; no true CEF parameters

nrmse_definition: RMS error / (max(reference)-min(reference)); full-spectrum reference spans all 540 points per model; observation reference spans fixed fit mask separately per temperature.
parameter_definition: max(abs(canonical_submission-reference)/abs(reference)) across all15 nonzero quantities, each model separately
provenance: Frozen before local results in kes_contract_prelocal.json. Source default3000 versus converged30000 budget sensitivity, not truth uncertainty. Resolution coefficient limits 5e-6 for slope and intercept separately; NCC cosine without centering >= .99; excitation deviation <= .1 meV; selected model and anisotropy exact. Canonical simultaneous B43/B63 sign gauge only.
physical_validity: Signed Gaussian FWHM reproduces source only over this measured finite domain. No global profile-normalization or high-energy calibration claim.
